name: accountable-review
description: Turns a pull request into a published review map — goal, behaviour flows carrying the API and client contract, where to start reading, impact paths through the unchanged code it gives new meaning to — so a reviewer can explain the change before judging it, at the depth the change is worth. Ships review-map for Rails and for Elixir/Phoenix, with or without a separate client, and setup-ci to generate one automatically on every review-ready pull request.
